text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.

WHEAT SALE - Pakistan awarded eight contracts for 450,000 tonnes of U.S. soft white wheat on Monday, with prices ranging from $152.48 to $155.56 per tonne FOB. The wheat was for delivery between March 10 and 31.

WHEAT SALE - Iran last week bought 300,000 tonnes of European Union soft wheat, mostly French, for shipment in April, European grain traders said. Several exporters cited an average selling price of around $140 per tonne, FOB. There was still no official confirmation of the deal.

DURUM SALE - Syria's recent sale of 40,000 tonnes of durum wheat is mostly destined to Libya, European grain exporters said on Monday. Syria's General Establishment for Cereal Processing and Trade said it sold 40,000 tonnes of hard amber durum wheat at $195 per tonne to a German company.

VEGOIL SALE - South Korea's National Livestock Cooperatives Federation bought 15,000 tonnes of Indian rapeseed meal and 10,000 tonnes of Chinese cottonseed meal. But the NLCF passed on tenders for 10,000 tonnes of rice bran, 10,000 tonnes of palm meal and 20,000 tonnes of copra due to high offer prices, said an NLCF official said.

CORN TENDER - Taiwan's FGEP corn procurement group will tender on Wednesday for one 54,000-tonne shipment of U.S. corn, traders said on Tuesday. The shipment would be slated for April 10-25 from the U.S. Gulf or April 26-May 10 from the Pacific Northwest.

DURUM TENDER - Tunisia confirmed it was tendering on Thursday for the purchase of four lots of 25,000 tonnes each of durum wheat. The state's buying body, Office des Cereales, said shipment dates were March 20-31, April 10-20, May 1-10, and May 20-31.

WHEAT TENDERS - The CCC said it will tender February 18 for 20,500 tonnes of northern spring/dark northern spring wheat for donation to Mozambique. The wheat is for March 5-31 shipment and must have a minimum protein of 12.5 percent.
MARKET TALK - Kenya is to import 639,000 tonnes of corn to cover a shortfall caused by a drought declared a national disaster and a production gap, food experts said.

MARKET TALK - cont'd ... Philippine Agriculture Secretary Salvador Escudero said Tuesday a local cornstarch manufacturer is set to import 25,000 tonnes of white corn from South Africa. Escudero told reporters the agriculture department has approved the import at a 35 percent tariff.

... Algeria still has credit outstanding to buy 84,000 tonnes of French wheat under an existing Coface credit line, French grain exporters and banking sources said on Monday. Algeria has launched a tender for the import of 125,000 tonnes of optional-origin soft wheat for shipment between April 1 and June 15. It plans to import 50,000 tonnes of wheat in April, 50,000 tonnes in May and 25,000 tonnes in the first half of June, they said.
... Tunisia has issued a regulation removing the state monopoly on imports of cereals by allowing private traders to import corn and soy pellets, grain traders said.
